candidates.label: Patmos (island)
candidates.support: Patmos is a small island of the Dodecanese in the Aegean Sea, undisputed in identity and location; Pleiades and Wikidata's coordinates for the island agree closely.

summary.text: Patmos is a small Aegean island where, per Revelation 1:9, John was present 'for the word of God and for the testimony of Jesus Christ' when he received the visions recorded in the Book of Revelation. UNESCO describes the island as 'reputed to be where Saint John the Theologian wrote both his Gospel and the Apocalypse around 95 AD,' a tradition commemorated since 1088 by the monastery built there in his honor.

scripture.textWEB: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
